darkModeBatch.promptPrefix: Create a new Neconyan dark-mode background, landscape 1536x1024. The first image is the soft storybook style reference; the second is the actual calico mascot identity reference. Use both actual images. Scene:
darkModeBatch.promptSuffix: Designed for someone chatting late at night in a dim room. Keep at least 85 percent of the image genuinely dark with low contrast. All large surfaces stay below a muted midtone; light sources are small, soft and dim. Polished gentle painted storybook illustration, cosy rounded forms, subtly textured matte colour, recognisable ivory/caramel/dark calico with closed eyes. Quiet dark centre with most detail at the outer edges, crops gracefully to a tall phone viewport. Full-bleed background artwork only, no lettering, text, logo, frame, UI or watermark. No bright white areas, neon, glare, large bright moon or bright horizon.
darkModeBatch.processing: Original 1536x1024 renders converted to progressive optimised RGB JPEG at quality 88. Each batch entry records its model; the top-level model remains the default for earlier entries.

themeMatchedBatch.references: Generated six-colour palette swatches from each named built-in theme, in the order listed in paletteFields.
